node: High-end AI-server MLCCs and board-level passive components
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the AI-server high-end MLCC and board-level passive-components node using a two-lane funnel. Murata is retained as the reference anchor because external search context directly ties it to AI-server MLCC density, low ESR/ESL requirements, and the narrow high-end MLCC bottleneck. The underfollowed lane emphasizes US-listed or US-traded component makers with plausible exposure to MLCCs, high-reliability capacitors, inductors, chokes, power magnetics, and data-center board/power infrastructure. Evidence is strongest for product capability and adjacency, but direct AI-server qualification or GB200/NVL72 customer exposure remains mostly unverified and should be treated as the key Layer 2 gating item.
